diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all rollouts despite PF2 not being accessible to the lone decision-maker. This indicates that the check is likely relying on a default value or a heuristic that always results in 2 autoclave loads, such as a hardcoded minimum load setting or an equal-split heuristic applied to the total load requirement.

C4.why: The autoclave assessment changes the sterilization plan to exactly 2 loads and exactly 12 reserved hours instead of an unspecified capacity and duration.
